text:
You need a remote BI contractor who can turn data into clear insights and also train others to use those insights effectively.

I’m Mina Castellan, and I bring 5 years of experience in data analysis and business intelligence work, with a strong focus on SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data cleaning, data visualization, and dashboard development. I’m comfortable working with messy data, organizing it into something reliable, and presenting it in a format that helps people make better decisions. Just as important, I can explain the process clearly so non-technical stakeholders can understand the work and use it with confidence.

Your posting stood out to me because it combines BI expertise with training skills. That combination matters: good reporting and analysis only create value when teams actually understand the data, trust it, and know how to act on it. I work in a practical, communication-focused way, so I can support both sides of that need—building useful BI outputs and helping others learn how to interpret and use them.

My core strengths match the kind of work you describe: SQL for querying and structuring data, Excel and Google Sheets for analysis and operational reporting, Power BI for dashboards and visualization, and data cleaning to improve accuracy and consistency. I also bring a problem-solving mindset and business acumen to help identify what matters most in the data, not just what can be reported.

I’d be glad to contribute to global projects where clear communication, strong analysis, and dependable delivery are essential. If selected, I’ll focus on producing clean, understandable BI work and communicating it in a way that supports training, adoption, and better decision-making.

I’d welcome the chance to discuss how I can help your team with business intelligence, dashboarding, and training support.
